## Checklist / 自查清单

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes (0 errors)
- [ ] `npm test` passes (full vitest suite)
- [ ] `npx tsx scripts/check-docs.mts` passes if README/docs changed
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests / 新行为有测试覆盖
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real IPs or `.env` content committed / 未提交密钥与敏感信息
- [ ] New API routes are auth-protected or explicitly marked public / 新路由有鉴权或显式标注
- [ ] ESM only — no `require()` leftovers / 无 require 残留
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-visible changes / 用户可见变更已更新日志
